title: user.locked (v1)
description: An administrator locked a user account. Emitted when an administrator sets the account state to "locked". All sessions and grants are revoked in the same transaction (session.revoked with reason "account_locked"). Automatic sign-in throttling does not change the account state and does not emit this event. Emitted by every successful call, even when the account was already in that state. org_id is never set.

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

user_id.description: The user whose account state changed.

org_id.description: Never set for this event type by the current server.
